documents.title: Kennedy inaugural address
documents.text: John F. Kennedy's 1961 inaugural address included the line: ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country.

documents.title: Public service theme
documents.text: The inaugural address urged Americans to contribute to public service, civic duty, and shared sacrifice rather than waiting for benefits from the government.

documents.title: Moon challenge
documents.text: President Kennedy challenged the United States to land a man on the Moon and return him safely to Earth before the decade was out.

documents.title: Cold War context
documents.text: Kennedy's early presidency was shaped by Cold War competition, alliance building, and strategic pressure with the Soviet Union.

documents.title: Vision pipeline note
documents.text: FastVLM on Snapdragon SM8750 uses the LiteRT NPU path for the vision encoder while the small projection adapter can remain on the CPU path.

documents.title: Thermal management note
documents.text: GraphPilot-Edge keeps a small plan bank with cool, warm, hot, and low-memory states so the runtime can switch plans without unstable continuous replanning.
